label: texify-420/encoder

provenance.summary: Texify Donut-Swin encoder (420×420, depths [2,2,14,2], window 5) as one NCHW WebNN graph. Window partition/reverse stay at rank 5; cyclic shift is slice+concat; relative-position bias and shifted-window masks are baked constants; packed QKV; 1/sqrt(32) folded into Q. Hoists all 8 decoder cross-attention K/V.

source.precision: float16 throughout; LayerNorm is the native WebNN op (a naive fp16 sum-of-squares overflows at Donut-Swin stage 2)
source.weightsExport: bench/webnn/texify/export_texify.py from the fp32 Hugging Face checkpoint

recordedFrom.recorder: bench/webnn/ir-record.js (Proxy around MLGraphBuilder; shapes are the backend's)
recordedFrom.label: encoder

folds: window partition/reverse as rank-5 reshape+transpose (Chrome 152 rejects rank 6)
cyclic shift as slice+concat (gather is --shift-style gather)
per-layer relative position bias [heads,25,25] and per-stage shift mask [nWin,25,25] as constants
packed QKV with 1/sqrt(head_dim) folded into Q (encoder head dim is 32 in every stage)
odd-side patch-merge pad 105→106, 53→54, 27→28 matching live Donut-Swin spatial sizes
native layerNormalization (fp16 sum-of-squares would overflow at stage 2)

note: One operand namespace: graph inputs keep their names, constants are k<N>, op results v<N>. Multi-output ops (split) list every result in `outputs`.
